description:
## Problem
After the withdrawal the old run path still works and would produce a non-specification result marked PASSED. A run with no validation evidence is labelled passed today (first review). This step is where the old run path stops.

## Owner decisions (choice dialogs, 2026-11-20)
- Refusal message, exactly: "TPC-DI is unavailable while BenchBox reworks it to run the specification's workload (historical load, two incremental updates, automated audit). Earlier BenchBox TPC-DI results were withdrawn." Exit code 2.
- Registry status: "`document_only` during the rework; `experimental` once DuckDB passes the full audit; `beta` only when at least three platforms pass it."
- "`--official` with TPC-DI is refused."
- "Old TPC-DI bundles a user still has load read-only as legacy and 'not validated'; compare, publish and submit refuse them."
- "UAT: TPC-DI is excluded through the registry status; the TPC-DI-specific prune rules are deleted."
- "'No validation evidence means not passed' applies to TPC-DI now; the same rule for other benchmarks is filed as a separate item."
- Old generator and ETL code stays in place, unreachable: "Keep to the letter: delete only after the DuckDB historical load passes its audit; the dead code is excluded from tests meanwhile."
- "the registry shows 0 queries while TPC-DI is unavailable."

## Change
Plan S4. Registry status `document_only`, new description, num_queries 0. One refusal check in core/run_service.py used by the run command, the MCP tool, the benchbox/tpcdi.py facade and TPCDIBenchmark's public entry points (generate_data, run_full_benchmark, run_etl_benchmark, calculate_official_metrics, execute_dataframe_workload). Result builder: a tpcdi result without a TPC-DI audit block is NOT_VALIDATED. Loader marks old TPC-DI bundles legacy. UAT matrix skips the status; delete the TPC-DI prune rules and their tests. Breaking changelog fragment.

## Decision gates
The breaking changelog entry's text is shown in the pull request description. If any result-construction path bypasses the builder, add the rule there and a test per constructor; if one cannot be covered, stop and report. Do not delete the old generator, ETL or query modules here.

## Verification rubric
Pass, each by a test that fails before the change: `benchbox run --benchmark tpcdi` (CliRunner) exits 2 with the exact message; the MCP run tool refuses; each listed Python entry point raises with the message; a tpcdi result with no audit block is NOT_VALIDATED and `publish_admission` returns non_clean; an old TPC-DI bundle loads as legacy and is refused by compare, publish and submit; `--official` with tpcdi is refused; the UAT resolver omits tpcdi. `make pr-preflight` exits 0. The pull request states which old modules remain and that nothing reaches them.

## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20)
- The agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`.
- Arming: `make pr-arm` once; one more attempt only when the refusal named a cause, the agent reported it and the cause is cleared; never a third without asking. `make pr-rerun` at most once and only for a job the runner never ran or cancelled, never for a failed test.
- Review threads: reply; resolve only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise the finding again.
- Subagents are read-only. No file edit by script; use the edit tool. Do not edit a pull request description while its CI is starting; post a comment.
- Any limit, default, threshold, status token, message or label text the owner has not already chosen (see tpcdi-correction-plan-20261120) is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- A blocked step stops this item; no workaround. No live cloud run. Heavy work only through `make heavy-run`. One pull request for this item, merged before the next item starts.
- From the quarantine step until the reopening step, no TPC-DI entry point may produce a result that reads PASSED or is admitted for publication.
